finalists.label: Sweet syndrome
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including facial crusted plaques, intradermal neutrophilic inflammation, and new-onset flulike symptoms.

finalists.label: Panniculitis
finalists.why: It is supported by the finding of septal panniculitis with Miescher radial granulomas, which is a distinctive feature.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including the characteristic facial lesions and intradermal neutrophilic inflammation.
